ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the upper waveform is labeled Vi, the horizontal axis is t, and it is sinusoidal; near the beginning, Vi rises from the zero point toward the positive half-cycle, then passes through the negative half-cycle, and repeats periodically. The lower waveform is labeled Vo, the horizontal axis is also t, and it is also sinusoidal, with basically the same shape and period as Vi; but at the same time positions, the polarity of Vo is opposite to that of Vi, for example when Vi is in the positive half-cycle, Vo is in the negative half-cycle, when Vi reaches near the positive peak, Vo corresponds to near the negative peak, and when Vi is in the negative half-cycle, Vo is in the positive half-cycle. Reasoning: Comparing the relationship between Vi and Vo at the same time points, the output waveform keeps the shape and period of the input waveform, but is always inverted in phase, that is, Vo and Vi have opposite polarities. This shows that this operational amplifier circuit implements the voltage inversion function, so it should be an inverter circuit, that is, an inverting operational amplifier circuit.

method.method_draft: Describe the two plotted waveforms, then compare Vi and Vo at several identical time instants. Note that the output always has opposite polarity to the input while preserving the waveform shape and period. Conclude that the circuit implements voltage inversion, so the circuit type is an inverter circuit, i.e. an inverting op-amp circuit.

method.method_draft: Treat the displayed input-output pair as sinusoidal steady-state signals. From the figure, identify that Vo has the same frequency as Vi but is phase-reversed by half a cycle. Map this 180-degree phase reversal to a negative transfer gain. Since the op-amp circuit whose defining function is negative gain is the inverter/inverting amplifier, answer: inverter circuit.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中上方标注为 Vi 的波形是随时间 t 变化的正弦波；下方标注为 Vo 的波形也是随时间 t 变化的正弦波。两者周期相同，但在同一时刻，当 Vi 从零点向正方向变化时，Vo 从零点向负方向变化；Vi 的正半周对应 Vo 的负半周，Vi 的负半周对应 Vo 的正半周。推理：因此输出 Vo 与输入 Vi 频率相同，但相位相差 180°，即 Vo 是 Vi 的反相输出。这对应运算放大器的负增益传输特性，实现这种电压转换功能的电路是反相器/反相放大器。
